verdict.rationale: Asking an auth framework for a test or sandbox mode is a fair question, since auth products can ship test environments or test helpers. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode or isolated test environment in Better Auth. Pointing Better Auth at a separate SQLite or Postgres database is a user-side workaround, not a product capability, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
